title: Down-slope acceleration
description: Essential: The response must correctly calculate the acceleration down the slope as 4 m/s².

title: Resistance force magnitude
description: Essential: The response must correctly calculate the resistance force on the slope as 70 N.

title: Horizontal slide time
description: Essential: The response must correctly calculate the time on the horizontal track as 2 s.

title: Correct kinematic application
description: Important: The solution must correctly apply kinematic equations (e.g., s = v₀t + ½at²) to find the down-slope acceleration.

title: Newton's second law on slope
description: Important: The solution must apply Newton's second law (mg sinθ - f = ma) to solve for the resistance force.

title: Velocity continuity
description: Important: The solution must recognize the final slope velocity is the initial horizontal velocity and calculate it correctly (22 m/s).

title: Horizontal motion analysis
description: Optional: The solution may explicitly calculate the deceleration on the horizontal track or verify the uniform motion assumption.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: The solution should present final answers with correct units (m/s², N, s).

title: Sign error in forces
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the force equation is incorrectly written (e.g., f = ma - mg sinθ) leading to a wrong sign or magnitude.

title: Kinematic misapplication
description: Pitfall: Penalize misuse of kinematic equations, such as using the wrong formula for the slope length or horizontal motion time.
